goal.zh: 确认 192.168.1.46 的管理服务（Telnet · 23）可从非管理网段访问。
goal.en: Confirm the administrative service (Telnet, 23) on 192.168.1.46 is reachable from a non-management segment.

authorization.zh: 仅在自有/已授权的内网（192.168.1.0/24）上执行只读验证；严禁越权或对第三方系统运行。
authorization.en: Read-only verification on your own authorized LAN (192.168.1.0/24) only; never exceed authorization or run against third-party systems.

expect.zh: Telnet 端口开放，说明管理面可从内网触达。
expect.en: The Telnet port is open, so the admin plane is reachable on the LAN.

note.zh: 只读连通性检查，不尝试任何登录。
note.en: Read-only reachability check; no login is attempted.

expect.zh: 版本探测回显管理服务横幅（如 Telnet/VNC）。
expect.en: Version detection returns the admin service banner (e.g. Telnet/VNC).

note.zh: 只读探测，不提交凭据。
note.en: Read-only probe; no credentials submitted.

expect.zh: 在授权下若能爆破/弱口令登入即证明可被接管（高层描述，非本报告执行）。
expect.en: Cracking valid or default credentials under authorization proves takeover risk (high-level; not run by this report).

note.zh: 审批门控的攻击动作，绝不自动执行，且严禁对生产运行。
note.en: Approval-gated attack action; never auto-executed and never to be run against production.

confirm.zh: 非管理网段可连上管理端口即确有暴露。
confirm.en: If the admin port answers from a non-management segment, the exposure is confirmed.

mitigated.zh: 管理端口仅从已审批管理网络可达、其它网段被拒 → 已缓解。
mitigated.en: Admin ports answer only from approved management networks and are refused elsewhere -> mitigated.

remediation.zh: 将管理访问限制到已审批的管理网络。
remediation.en: Restrict administrative access to approved management networks.

goal.zh: 确认数据库/存储端口 192.168.1.250:5432（PostgreSQL）从非受控网段可达并回显握手/版本。
goal.en: Confirm the datastore port 192.168.1.250:5432 (PostgreSQL) is reachable and returns a handshake/version banner from an uncontrolled segment.

authorization.zh: 仅在自有/已授权的内网（192.168.1.0/24）上执行只读验证；严禁越权或对第三方系统运行。
authorization.en: Read-only verification on your own authorized LAN (192.168.1.0/24) only; never exceed authorization or run against third-party systems.

expect.zh: 端口开放（succeeded/open），说明数据库/存储服务对内网可达。
expect.en: Port is open (succeeded/open), so the datastore is reachable on the LAN.

note.zh: 只做 TCP 连通性检查，不认证。
note.en: TCP reachability check only; no authentication.

expect.zh: 服务探测回显 PostgreSQL 握手/版本横幅。
expect.en: Service probe returns the PostgreSQL handshake/version banner.

note.zh: 只读横幅探测，不提交任何查询或凭据。
note.en: Read-only banner probe; no query or credential is sent.

steps.cmd: psql 'host=192.168.1.250 port=5432 user=postgres'  # GATED: 未授权/默认口令连接需审批；凭据从缺 / unauthenticated or default-credential connect, approval-gated, credentials withheld

expect.zh: 在授权下若能无凭据或用默认口令连入即确证暴露（高层描述，非本报告执行）。
expect.en: Connecting with no or default credentials under authorization confirms exposure (high-level; not run by this report).

note.zh: 审批门控的攻击动作，绝不自动执行，且严禁对生产运行。
note.en: Approval-gated attack action; never auto-executed and never to be run against production.

confirm.zh: 数据库/存储端口从非受控网段可达/可握手即确有暴露。
confirm.en: If the datastore port is reachable and answers a handshake from an uncontrolled segment, exposure is confirmed.

mitigated.zh: 服务仅在已审批访问控制之后可达、外部连接被拒 → 已缓解。
mitigated.en: The datastore is reachable only behind approved access control and external connections are refused -> mitigated.

remediation.zh: 将数据库服务置于已审批的访问控制之后。
remediation.en: Place the database service behind approved access control.

findings.title: 管理服务对外暴露：admin-web (8443), admin-web (9000)

goal.zh: 确认 192.168.1.17 的管理服务（admin-web · 8443,9000）可从非管理网段访问。
goal.en: Confirm the administrative service (admin-web, 8443,9000) on 192.168.1.17 is reachable from a non-management segment.

authorization.zh: 仅在自有/已授权的内网（192.168.1.0/24）上执行只读验证；严禁越权或对第三方系统运行。
authorization.en: Read-only verification on your own authorized LAN (192.168.1.0/24) only; never exceed authorization or run against third-party systems.

expect.zh: admin-web 端口开放，说明管理面可从内网触达。
expect.en: The admin-web port is open, so the admin plane is reachable on the LAN.

note.zh: 只读连通性检查，不尝试任何登录。
note.en: Read-only reachability check; no login is attempted.

expect.zh: 返回 HTTP 200/401/403，说明管理界面可从内网触达。
expect.en: HTTP 200/401/403 shows the admin UI is reachable on the LAN.

note.zh: 只读头部请求，不提交凭据。
note.en: Read-only header request; no credentials submitted.

steps.cmd: hydra 192.168.1.17 -s 9000 http-get /  # GATED: 凭据爆破需审批；字典从缺

expect.zh: 在授权下若能爆破/弱口令登入即证明可被接管（高层描述，非本报告执行）。
expect.en: Cracking valid or default credentials under authorization proves takeover risk (high-level; not run by this report).

note.zh: 审批门控的攻击动作，绝不自动执行，且严禁对生产运行。
note.en: Approval-gated attack action; never auto-executed and never to be run against production.

confirm.zh: 非管理网段可连上管理端口即确有暴露。
confirm.en: If the admin port answers from a non-management segment, the exposure is confirmed.

mitigated.zh: 管理端口仅从已审批管理网络可达、其它网段被拒 → 已缓解。
mitigated.en: Admin ports answer only from approved management networks and are refused elsewhere -> mitigated.

remediation.zh: 将管理访问限制到已审批的管理网络。
remediation.en: Restrict administrative access to approved management networks.

findings.title: TLS 疑似陈旧/过期（响应头日期 11 Jul 2021 · TLSv1.2）

goal.zh: 确认 192.168.1.250:443 的 TLS 证书陈旧/过期或使用弱协议（观测响应头日期 11 Jul 2021）。
goal.en: Confirm the TLS on 192.168.1.250:443 uses an old/expired certificate or weak protocol (observed response Date 11 Jul 2021).

authorization.zh: 仅在自有/已授权的内网（192.168.1.0/24）上执行只读验证；严禁越权或对第三方系统运行。
authorization.en: Read-only verification on your own authorized LAN (192.168.1.0/24) only; never exceed authorization or run against third-party systems.

expect.zh: notAfter 若早于当前时间说明证书已过期；核对签发/到期日期。
expect.en: If notAfter is earlier than now the certificate is expired; verify the issue/expiry dates.

note.zh: 只读证书检查，不发送应用数据。
note.en: Read-only certificate check; no application data sent.

expect.zh: 响应头 Date 显示陈旧时间（观测为 11 Jul 2021），提示服务长期未更新。
expect.en: The response Date header shows a stale time (observed 11 Jul 2021), indicating a long-unmaintained service.

note.zh: 只读头部请求，不提交凭据。
note.en: Read-only header request; no credentials submitted.

expect.zh: 若出现 TLSv1.0/1.1 或被评为弱（C/F）的套件即确认弱加密。
expect.en: TLSv1.0/1.1 or ciphers graded weak (C/F) confirm weak TLS.

note.zh: 只读协议/套件枚举。
note.en: Read-only protocol/cipher enumeration.

confirm.zh: 证书过期/陈旧或出现弱协议/弱套件即确有问题。
confirm.en: An expired/stale certificate or a weak protocol/cipher confirms the issue.

mitigated.zh: 证书在有效期内、仅启用 TLSv1.2+ 与强套件 → 已缓解。
mitigated.en: The certificate is valid and only TLSv1.2+ with strong ciphers is enabled -> mitigated.

remediation.zh: 整改 TLS 策略与证书配置。
remediation.en: Remediate TLS policy and certificate configuration.

findings.title: 过时版本：dropbear 2011.54（22），建议核对官方公告

goal.zh: 核实 192.168.1.46:22 运行过时版本（观测：dropbear 2011.54），仅作版本核对，不做利用。
goal.en: Verify 192.168.1.46:22 runs an outdated version (observed: dropbear 2011.54); version check only, no exploitation.

authorization.zh: 仅在自有/已授权的内网（192.168.1.0/24）上执行只读验证；严禁越权或对第三方系统运行。
authorization.en: Read-only verification on your own authorized LAN (192.168.1.0/24) only; never exceed authorization or run against third-party systems.

expect.zh: 版本探测与横幅一致（dropbear 2011.54）。
expect.en: Version detection matches the banner (dropbear 2011.54).

note.zh: 只读版本探测。
note.en: Read-only version detection.

expect.zh: 读取横幅确认版本为 dropbear 2011.54。
expect.en: Read the banner to confirm the version is dropbear 2011.54.

note.zh: 只读横幅读取；不断言具体 CVE，建议核对官方公告。
note.en: Read-only banner read; asserts no specific CVE, check the vendor advisory.

confirm.zh: 版本确为过时 → 建议核对官方公告并按变更流程升级。
confirm.en: If the version is confirmed outdated -> check the vendor advisory and upgrade via the change process.

mitigated.zh: 已升级到受支持版本或按公告确认不受影响 → 已缓解。
mitigated.en: Upgraded to a supported version or confirmed unaffected per the advisory -> mitigated.

remediation.zh: 持续只读监控并核实资产归属。
remediation.en: Continue readonly monitoring and ownership validation.

hardening.action: 将管理访问限制到已审批的管理网络。
将数据库服务置于已审批的访问控制之后。
整改 TLS 策略与证书配置。
持续只读监控并核实资产归属。
